strings.zh: ⋯⋯这场对战{NEWLINE}真是精彩绝伦！{SCROLL}为了留作纪念,{NEWLINE}我要把你记下来！{SCROLL}你能把电话号码{NEWLINE}告诉给我吗？{SCROLL}虽然我经常要修行,{NEWLINE}可能没什么时间打电话⋯⋯{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Our battle was remarkable!{SCROLL}I wish for something to remember{NEWLINE}you by!{SCROLL}Perhaps your phone number will do?{SCROLL}My training makes it impossible to{NEWLINE}chat much, but... {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 为了变得更强,{NEWLINE}我要继续修行！
strings.en: I must train harder to become{NEWLINE}the mightiest!

strings.zh: 如果你想要我电话的话{NEWLINE}再来找我吧！
strings.en: If you decide you want my number, come{NEWLINE}and find me.

strings.zh: 虽然我在修行的时候{NEWLINE}可能没什么机会和你聊天,{CLEAR}不过我们能交换下号码吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: My training makes chatting tough.{NEWLINE}So, take down my number? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 今天我想要谢谢{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}！{SCROLL}因为我在进行孤独的修行时{NEWLINE}给我打了个电话⋯⋯{CLEAR}真是太高兴了！！{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}！{NEWLINE}你能收下这个吗！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Today, I’d like to thank you,{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}!{SCROLL}I’ve been training all alone...{NEWLINE}I was happy that you cared to call...{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}! I want you to have this!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 如果再有行李的话,{NEWLINE}估计以你的力气是拿不动了！{SCROLL}在你的行李重量减轻之前,{NEWLINE}我来帮你保管好了！
strings.en: Your strength will not let you carry{NEWLINE}another thing! I will hold this till you{CLEAR}lighten your Bag!

strings.zh: 什么？{NEWLINE}要是你在附近的话,{CLEAR}直接找我聊天就行了！
strings.en: Excuse me?{NEWLINE}If you’re nearby, then I’d appreciate{CLEAR}the politeness of talking face-to-face!

strings.zh: 你在继续你的旅行吗？{NEWLINE}我的修行{CLEAR}也同样无止尽！{CLEAR}哈！！
strings.en: Are you still on your journey? My{NEWLINE}training has no end, either! Hah!!

strings.zh: 抱歉,现在我正在修行,{NEWLINE}实在是抽不开身！{SCROLL}明天我就有时间打电话了,{NEWLINE}嘿哈！！
strings.en: My apologies, but I don’t have time to{NEWLINE}chat while I am in training!{SCROLL}I’ll have time to chat tomorrow!{NEWLINE}Yiiihah!

strings.zh: 我今天准备休息一下！{CLEAR}你来陪我玩玩吧！！
strings.en: I’m taking a break today!{NEWLINE}Come and keep me company!!

strings.zh: 现在我在４５号道路休息！{SCROLL}要是你有时间的话{NEWLINE}就和我再来对战一场吧！
strings.en: I’m taking a break on Route 45!{NEWLINE}Why not drop by? We can have a battle!

strings.zh: 今天休息得够久了！{NEWLINE}现在我又要开始修行了！{CLEAR}嘿！哈！
strings.en: I’ve rested long enough today! Now{NEWLINE}it’s back to training! Hey! Hah!
